targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS v FROM commands_history WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id <> 0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS v FROM commands_history WHERE Date >= UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id <> 0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS v FROM commands_history WHERE Date >= UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id <> 0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS v FROM commands_history WHERE Date >= UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id <> 0

SELECT COUNT(*) AS v FROM (
  SELECT user_id FROM commands_history
  WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id <> 0
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING MIN(Date) >= UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
) t

SELECT COUNT(*) AS v FROM (
  SELECT user_id FROM commands_history
  WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id <> 0
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING MIN(Date) >= UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
) t
SELECT COUNT(*) AS v FROM commands_history
SELECT COUNT(*) AS v FROM commands_history WHERE Date >= UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
SELECT COUNT(*) AS v FROM commands_history WHERE Date >= UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
SELECT COUNT(*) AS v FROM commands_history WHERE Date >= UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 30 DAY

SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT user_id), 0), 1) AS v
FROM commands_history WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id <> 0

SELECT ROUND(100 * SUM(Success = 1) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS v
FROM commands_history
WHERE Date >= UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 7 DAY

panels.title: Rétention 7 j

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(100 * SUM(seen_prev = 1 AND seen_last = 1) / NULLIF(SUM(seen_prev = 1), 0), 1) AS v
FROM (
  SELECT user_id,
    MAX(Date >= UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS seen_last,
    MAX(Date >= UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND Date < UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS seen_prev
  FROM commands_history
  WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id <> 0
  GROUP BY user_id
) u

panels.description: Part des joueurs actifs les 7 jours précédents qui sont revenus sur les 7 derniers jours.

panels.title: Rétention 30 j

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(100 * SUM(seen_prev = 1 AND seen_last = 1) / NULLIF(SUM(seen_prev = 1), 0), 1) AS v
FROM (
  SELECT user_id,
    MAX(Date >= UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AS seen_last,
    MAX(Date >= UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 60 DAY AND Date < UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AS seen_prev
  FROM commands_history
  WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id <> 0
  GROUP BY user_id
) u

panels.description: Part des joueurs actifs les 30 jours précédents qui sont revenus sur les 30 derniers jours.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "pupsbot")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_container_status" and r._field == "uptime_ns")
  |> group(columns: ["container_name", "container_status"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({service: r.container_name, etat: r.container_status, depuis: float(v: r._value) / 1000000000.0}))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["service"])

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(Date,'1d'),
  COUNT(DISTINCT IF(user_id <> 0, user_id, NULL)) AS joueurs
FROM commands_history
WHERE $__timeFilter(Date)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(Date,'1d'),
  COUNT(*) AS commandes
FROM commands_history
WHERE $__timeFilter(Date)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT LOWER(TRIM(LEADING '!' FROM SUBSTRING_INDEX(TRIM(command_input), ' ', 1))) AS commande,
  COUNT(*) AS total
FROM commands_history
WHERE $__timeFilter(Date)
GROUP BY commande
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 12

SELECT Date AS Heure, username AS Joueur, command_input AS Commande, Success AS Ok, ROUND(elapsed_time) AS ms
FROM commands_history
WHERE $__timeFilter(Date)
ORDER BY Date DESC
LIMIT 20

targets.query:
from(bucket: "pupsbot")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "suggestion" and r._field == "pp")
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: count, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "suggestions"}))

from(bucket: "pupsbot")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "suggestion" and r._field == "pp")
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "pp"}))

from(bucket: "pupsbot")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "service_performance" and r.serviceType == "system" and r.operation == "memory_rss" and r._field == "duration")
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "Mémoire"}))

from(bucket: "pupsbot")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "service_performance" and r.serviceType == "system" and r.operation == "eventloop_lag_mean" and r._field == "duration")
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "Délai moyen"}))

mem = from(bucket: "pupsbot")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_container_mem" and (r._field == "usage" or r._field == "usage_percent"))
  |> group(columns: ["container_name", "_field"])
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["container_name"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
cpu = from(bucket: "pupsbot")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_container_cpu" and r._field == "usage_percent")
  |> group(columns: ["container_name"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({container_name: r.container_name, cpu: r._value}))
join(tables: {mem: mem, cpu: cpu}, on: ["container_name"])
  |> keep(columns: ["container_name", "usage", "usage_percent", "cpu"])
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["usage"], desc: true)

  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "rate_limiter" and r._field == "requestsInLastMinute" and exists r.pool)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: if r.pool == "home" then "Maison" else if r.pool == "pulse" then "Pulseheberg" else if r.pool == "cf" then "Cloudflare" else if r.pool == "friend" then "Ami" else if r.pool == "total" then "Total" else r.pool}))
